mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_item_id as cartItemId, c.product_id as productId, p.name as name, (SELECT image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 1) as image, COALESCE(p.discount_price, p.price) as price, c.size_name as sizeName, c.quantity as quantity FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (member_id, product_id, size_name, quantity, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{sizeName}, #{quantity}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
